entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: An elemental god, living embodiment of Lorwyn and a symbol of the sun; twin worldsoul of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor with Isilu.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: Incarnation of the moon and Eirdu's counterpart.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Ruler whose downfall merged Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Faerie planeswalker who disturbed Isilu's rest.

entities.name: Adherents of Eirdu
entities.description: Worshipers who seek to convert the plane into Lorwyn.

events.summary: After Oona's downfall Eirdu and Isilu reawaken from the firmament.
events.quote: two great beings reawakened from the firmament above the plane

events.summary: Isilu and Eirdu find a balance.
events.quote: Isilu and Eirdu found a balance

events.summary: Oko disturbs Isilu's rest using visiting students, destabilizing the balance.
events.quote: caused Isilu's rest to be disturbed

events.summary: Adherents perform the Festival of Idyllglare with a pyre and an Eirdu costume.
events.quote: perform sacraments in the Festival of Idyllglare
